objective:
Improve the ACTUAL playable C01 Shadow Printshop game UI.

PRIMARY GOAL:
Improve the visual quality, readability, layout,
and user experience of the existing eight-puzzle game.

This is a REAL GAME IMPLEMENTATION task.
Do not produce documentation-only changes.

FEATURES TO IMPLEMENT:

1. VISUAL HIERARCHY
- Improve title and puzzle information hierarchy.
- Clearly distinguish CURRENT, AFTER and TARGET boards.
- Improve alignment, spacing and panel organization.
- Maintain a cohesive paper, wood and ink visual theme.

2. BUTTONS AND CONTROLS
- Improve normal, hover, pressed, focused and disabled states.
- Maintain clear keyboard focus indicators.
- Improve consistency between primary and secondary actions.
- Preserve all existing input bindings.

3. PUZZLE PROGRESSION
- Make puzzle number and overall progress clearer.
- Improve completed-puzzle information.
- Make the NEXT action visually understandable.
- Preserve the existing final completion behavior.

4. RESPONSIVE LAYOUT
- Support 1280x720 and 1920x1080.
- Avoid overlapping or clipped interface elements.
- Maintain readability at existing font-scale settings.
- Preserve the existing scroll behavior when necessary.

5. ACCESSIBILITY
- Preserve readable color contrast.
- Do not rely on color alone to explain board states.
- Respect reduced-motion settings.
- Preserve keyboard and mouse accessibility.

STRICT REQUIREMENTS:

- Preserve all eight puzzles and their solutions.
- Preserve XOR mechanics and game progression.
- Preserve print, undo and completion animations.
- Preserve all existing audio behavior.
- Preserve save/load and first-puzzle guidance.
- Do not change puzzle data.
- Do not modify existing tests or QA assertions.
- Do not modify harness files or project settings.
- Do not add dependencies or external assets.
- Do not make Git commits.

Implement actual, visible UI improvements using existing
Godot scenes and scripts.

VALIDATION:
- Godot IMPORT
- Smoke tests
- Regression tests
- Slice acceptance
- Windows export

If a blocker requires changes outside the allowlist,
report the exact issue without bypassing safeguards.

Prioritize working game improvements over harness development.
